title: Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL, Fabric
description: A SQL Server database, an Azure SQL database, or a Microsoft Fabric warehouse or SQL endpoint — with a SQL login or an Entra service principal.

fields.name: auth
fields.label: Sign in with
fields.help: sql: a SQL login. entra: an Entra (Azure AD) service principal — Azure SQL and Fabric.

fields.name: user
fields.label: User
fields.help: A login that can only read (db_datareader): Superatom checks every query is a read, but SQL Server has no read-only session.

fields.name: encrypt
fields.label: Encrypt
fields.help: true (the default) unless the server has no certificate.
